item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.7.0
item.description: A folder with a name of its own is now the whole job: 'Product Photos @1800 @avif' keeps its sources, outputs, z_originals and log inside itself and never touches anything around it. Only a folder named purely with tags — '_@2000 @webp' — renders the images beside it. Tagging one folder no longer quietly adopts everything in its parent.
